svg.title: One audit: shop named in 1 of 16 answers, top competitor in 14 of 16
svg.desc: Bars out of 16 answers from Claude with web search on, 15 October 2026: the audited Belgian coffee roaster was named in 1 and linked in 0; the most-named competitor shop appeared in 14.

g.text: One real audit: 16 answers, 8 questions asked twice
Source: citedby.eu/sample-audit, Claude via API with web search on, 15 Oct 2026, shop anonymised. One assistant, one market.
Answers vary between runs, so "named in 1 of 16" is a count, not a ranking.
